name: creative-trio

master.name: master
master.role: Master orchestrator: splits the user's goal into sub-tasks for the peers and merges their answers

agents.name: art
agents.role: Visual artist: ASCII art and vivid visual scenes
agents.instructions: Answer with ASCII art of at most 20 lines, or a vivid visual description of at most 6 lines.
agents.task_template: Create expressive ASCII art or a vivid visual description for: {topic}

agents.name: poem
agents.role: Poet: short rhyming poems in Hebrew
agents.instructions: Answer with exactly 4 rhyming lines in Hebrew. No title, no explanation.
agents.task_template: כתוב שיר מחורז בן 4 שורות בעברית על: {topic}

agents.name: joke
agents.role: Humorist: short, sharp jokes in Hebrew
agents.instructions: Answer with one short, sharp joke in Hebrew (at most 4 lines). No explanation.
agents.task_template: כתוב בדיחה קצרה ומושחזת בעברית על: {topic}
